newsitem.title: INDIA: Divers find 61 bodies after Indian lake accident.
newsitem.headline: Divers find 61 bodies after Indian lake accident.

text.p: Divers have recovered the bodies of 61 people after a bus plunged into a southern Indian lake last Wednesday, police said on Saturday.

A senior police official in Karnataka state told Reuters that it took a day to locate the vehicle and two days to empty water from the artificial lake near Chitradurga, 180 km (110 miles) from the state capital Bangalore.

The accident occurred when passengers were trying to push-start the bus on a slope. The driver lost control and the vehicle, with about 70 people aboard, plunged into the 100-foot (30-metre) deep lake built near a Hindu temple.
Nine people who were near the bus doors managed to swim to safety. The rest drowned in the lake which was swollen by monsoon rains, police said.
